# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v3 c26 P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a fat woman who walks with a waddle. She is a notable housewife who keeps a remarkably clean and orderly home. She can often be seen sitting at her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on the main road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a very capable, outspoken, and inquisitive woman who prided herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. She takes an intense interest in her neighbors' business and loves to create a sensation. Despite her sharp tongue and officious nature, she possesses a very kind heart, frequently helping the poor and offering neighbors her assistance in times of trouble.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P30](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0030), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v3 c26 P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for many years in Lynde's Hollow with her husband Thomas, managing her household, running the Sewing Circle, helping with the Sunday School, and supporting church missions. When Matthew Cuthbert drove past her house in a best suit, her curiosity led her to visit Green Gables, where she learned the Cuthberts intended to adopt an orphan boy. Upon meeting the newly arrived Anne Shirley, Rachel's blunt criticism of her appearance provoked a fiery outburst from the girl, though she later accepted Anne's dramatic apology and grew fond of her. Throughout Anne's school and college years, Mrs. Rachel frequently gave advice on her upbringing, church affairs, and local gossip. When her husband Thomas fell ill, she nursed him faithfully until his death. Following his passing and the necessity to sell their mortgaged farm, she accepted Marilla's invitation to move into Green Gables, taking up residence in the renovated north gable room while helping Marilla manage the house and twins.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v3 c26 P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 c26 P14](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0014), [v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021)_
